classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and rank representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097167) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097163) activities, complemented by InterPro family membership, expanded via GPU-accelerated sequence-similarity search, biochemically characterised, and ranked for representativeness.
assumptions: GO:0097167 is the canonical MF term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity; GO:0097163 is the canonical MF term for NADPHX epimerase activity — both are used without confirmation as they are the standard GO assignments for NAD(P)HX repair enzymes.
IPR023753 is used as the primary InterPro heuristic for the NAD(P)HX repair protein family; IPR007867 (YjeF_N domain) is the recommended fallback if IPR023753 returns zero sequences.
UniRef90 is assumed to be available as a prebuilt local MMseqs2 database under the identifier 'UniRef90' for representative-sequence expansion.
Only Swiss-Prot reviewed entries (reviewed=true) are retrieved from GO and InterPro queries to ensure annotation quality and minimise spurious hits.
IEA (Inferred from Electronic Annotation) evidence codes are excluded from GO queries; only manually curated annotations are retained.
Sequence analysis is performed at pH 7.4 (physiological cytoplasmic pH); all charge and composition values reflect this condition.
MMseqs2 search parameters (min_seq_id=0.3, coverage=0.8, sensitivity=7.5) are chosen to capture remote homologs while excluding fragment matches.
top_k=20 is used for the final rank_designs call as the representative ranked output size.
No experimental or predicted structures are available as inputs; the entire workflow is sequence-level and no structure-based tools are included.
The ranked output provides sufficient composition, charge, motif, and annotation data to support Reason: and Answer: fields in a final scientific response.

success_criteria.ranked_candidates_returned: rank_designs returns top 20 NAD(P)HX repair protein representative sequences with composite ranking scores
success_criteria.dual_activity_classes_covered: both dehydratase (GO:0097167) and epimerase (GO:0097163) sequence sets retrieved and included in analysis
success_criteria.interpro_family_captured: InterPro family sequences retrieved via IPR023753 to complement GO-annotated seed sets
success_criteria.similarity_expansion_done: mmseqs2_gpu expands dehydratase and epimerase seed sets into broader representative homolog sets from UniRef90
success_criteria.biochemical_profiles_complete: sequence_analysis results cover composition, charge at pH 7.4, regions, motifs, and per-residue annotations for all three candidate groups
